meta.name: subject-line-lab
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "generate subject line variants", "pre-score my subject lines", or "will this subject get truncated / trigger spam filters"; produces a labeled subject + preheader variant set and a per-variant heuristic pre-score card — spam-trigger flags, length/truncation across desktop + mobile, emoji-count, and the inbox preview render (from-name + subject + preheader) — before any test is run. Not for the body copy or CTA — use email-creative-builder; not for the A/B test design or significance read — use send-experiment-designer; not for the profile-weighted EQS or the S1/S2/N1/D1 vetoes — use email-quality-auditor. 邮件主题行生成/主题行预打分/截断与垃圾词检查

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成邮件主题行变体并预打分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为邮件营销撰写和优化主题行。
copy.tagline_en: Generate email subject line variants with pre-scoring
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write and optimize email subject lines for campaigns.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成 3-8 个带标签的主题行+预览文本变体，并为每个变体做预打分：检查垃圾邮件触发词、桌面和手机端的截断情况、表情符号数量，并渲染收件箱预览（发件人+主题+预览文本）。最后给出排名，推荐优胜变体进入 A/B 测试。
howto.when: 当你要求“生成主题行变体”、“预打分我的主题行”，或询问“这个主题会被截断/触发垃圾邮件过滤器吗”时触发。

say.text: 为这个促销活动生成 5 个主题行变体，促销模式。
say.note: Claude 会生成变体并预打分。

say.text: 预打分这 6 个主题行，检查截断和垃圾邮件触发词。
say.note: Claude 会分析你提供的主题行。

say.text: 显示我的前 3 个主题行在桌面和手机上的收件箱预览。
say.note: Claude 会渲染预览并标记截断问题。

howto.what_en: Generates 3-8 labeled subject line + preheader variants, heuristically pre-scores each for spam triggers, desktop/mobile truncation, emoji count, and renders inbox preview (from-name + subject + preheader). Ranks survivors for A/B testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'generate subject line variants', 'pre-score my subject lines', or 'will this subject get truncated / trigger spam filters'.

say_en.text: Generate 5 subject line variants for this promo, promo mode.
say_en.note: Claude will generate variants and pre-score them.

say_en.text: Pre-score these 6 subject lines for truncation and spam triggers.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze your provided subject lines.

say_en.text: Show inbox preview for my top 3 on desktop and mobile.
say_en.note: Claude will render previews and flag truncation.
